description: G1 golden set — classification. Correctly classified arc texts for the four named categories (spec §2.5.3) plus genuinely-ambiguous unclassified, floor behavior, and process identification including the known 'military escalation hijack' hard case and the no-process/no-arc rule. Expected values derived from the category definitions and verified against the repaired classifyArc/findProcess/applyFloor.

categoryCases.name: police_inquiry
categoryCases.text: The inquiry into police misconduct found failings at every level. The report found negligence and evidence of a cover-up.

categoryCases.name: iran_houthi_escalation
categoryCases.text: Iran launched missiles at the base amid escalation. The Houthis threatened Red Sea shipping and tankers rerouted.

categoryCases.name: rate_rise
categoryCases.text: The central bank raised interest rates as inflation hit a new high. Markets fell and oil prices rose.

categoryCases.name: senate_bill
categoryCases.text: The senate passes the bill after a close vote. The legislation now heads for amendment in committee stage.

categoryCases.name: ambiguous_unclassified
categoryCases.text: Local team wins championship in dramatic final. Fans celebrated long into the night across the city.

categoryCases.name: weak_signal_below_floor
categoryCases.text: Markets moved today in quiet trading.

processCases.name: trade_war_not_hijacked
processCases.text: Trump announced new tariffs on China. The trade war escalated as Beijing vowed counter-strikes on US goods.
processCases.note: hub-entity hard case (Trump, China): bare 'strike' must not let 'military escalation' hijack a trade story

processCases.name: prosecution
processCases.text: Police arrested a suspect on Tuesday. He was charged and jailed after the trial concluded.

processCases.name: wildfire_response
processCases.text: Wildfires swept across Spain. Thousands evacuated as the storm fanned the flames.

processCases.name: investigation_process
processCases.text: The probe into the ministry deepened. Investigators found new evidence.

processCases.name: no_process_no_arc
processCases.text: The weather was pleasant on Sunday. People enjoyed the park across the city.
processCases.note: no identifiable process => NO arc; the 'developments' placeholder must never return
